$comment: Vendor, model and device command-language names that must not appear in packages/* or apps/* (ARCHITECTURE §3.8). Matched case-insensitively as whole words. plugins/ and docs/research/ are exempt. Shared with scripts/check-vendor-neutral.ts (Spec 001).

allowedCommandLanguages.description: HP-GL/2 is the de facto standard cutter command language; a generic encoder belongs in packages/cut-export. Exact, case-sensitive tokens only: a bare vendor name or a model name is still flagged outside plugins/.
